name: Right-libertarianism
notAnIdeology: Duplicate of 'libertarianism': audits/profiles/libertarianism.json is explicitly scoped to mainstream contemporary right-libertarianism (Nozick, the Libertarian Party platform, Cato-style libertarianism), and the Wikipedia and Stanford Encyclopedia articles describe right-libertarianism as the self-ownership and strong-property-rights family that the plain term 'libertarianism' denotes in the United States; its anarcho-capitalist strand has its own audit.
